variants.title: A movement revealed in three chapters
variants.navigation: Quiet house masthead; local craft/calibre links; one configuration destination. The watch has scroll, drag, arrow and range controls.

ordered_sections.pattern: Short editorial column left of a full-height sticky watch; small chapter number and one configuration action
Two further scroll chapters share the sticky watch, with the dial progressively transparent
Asymmetric title and four large ruled tabular figures
A close crop of the same original movement opposite three restrained craft steps
Warm light invitation and a complete local booking form

variants.mobile_reflow: The 72 svh watch precedes the text; native range and buttons replace dependence on sticky scrolling. Chapters, figures, craft and booking stack without cropped controls.
distinguishing_features: A live watch, not a decorative medal
Three scroll chapters share one object instead of repeated hero cards
A light local service closes the dark narrative

variants.title: A personal watch and exact-price selection desk
variants.navigation: Return to the movement story, inspect choices, review the selection ledger and prepare a local fitting.

ordered_sections.pattern: Left sticky watch with a separate warm light specification panel on the right
Full-width warm light spread with a ruled choice and price ledger
Four dark ruled figures, without scrolling chapters
Complete light booking form with the selected watch carried into its local confirmation
content_requirements: Same date and time validation as A
Exact configuration and total in confirmation

variants.mobile_reflow: The watch keeps its 72 svh stage, then the entire choice panel and ledger follow in one column. No sticky panel or floating checkout covers controls.
distinguishing_features: An inverted dark object/light selection desk rather than A’s editorial scroll
All 27 combinations change both rendering paths
A real, itemised price ledger and reservation snapshot
